::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/payment_methods/setup"}
#docs
Returns an approval_url the buyer visits; the approved setup_token is then completed via POST …/payment_methods.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `string` | **yes** | The payment provider to set up. One of `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `authorizenet`, `square`, `mollie`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `return_url` | `string` | **yes** | Where to send the customer after they finish. |
| `cancel_url` | `string` | **yes** | Where to send the customer if they cancel. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `provider` | `string` | The payment provider. |
| `setup_token` | `string` | The token the client uses to complete the setup. |
| `mode` | `string` | How the customer completes the setup: `redirect`, `checkout`, `client_secret`, `sdk` or `form_post`. One of `redirect`, `checkout`, `client_secret`, `sdk`, `form_post`. |
| `approval_url` | `string` | redirect mode (PayPal): buyer visits this to approve. |
| `checkout` | `object` | checkout mode (RazorPay): params for the embedded checkout. |
| `client_secret` | `string` | client_secret mode (Stripe): the secret the browser confirms with. |
| `publishable_key` | `string` | The gateway's publishable key. |
| `sdk` | `object` | For `mode: sdk`: run this gateway's browser SDK with `params`. Post what the SDK returns as `client_result` with the completion request. |
| `form_post` | `object` | For `mode: form_post`: submit `fields` as a top-level HTML form POST to `action`. The gateway sends the buyer back to the return URL with a POST. |
| `payment_intent` | `string` | The setup intent (`pi_…`) this add-card is recorded as. |
| `next_action` | `object` | How the buyer completes the challenge, when one is outstanding. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Unsupported provider / invalid body |
| `404` | No such customer |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_methods/setup" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "stripe",
    "return_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing",
    "cancel_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing"
  }'
```
